name: Te Awarua o Porirua Community Environment Fund

funder.name: Greater Wellington Regional Council with Porirua Harbour Accord partners

summary: Annual small grants for volunteer community groups, schools and Māori guardianship groups doing native planting, stream and wetland restoration and pest control in the Porirua Harbour catchment near Wellington.

geography.label: Te Awarua o Porirua Harbour catchment, Wellington region

reporting: A brief annual report on a provided template, and possibly a site visit to see how the funds were spent.
